name: Waters
outlook:
What Waters says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: total revenueTotal Company reported revenue for the fourth quarter of 2026 is expected to be in the range of $1.801 billion to $1.819 billion.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: adjusted EPSThe Company expects fourth quarter 2026 adjusted EPS to be in the range of $4.58 to $4.68, which represents 1% to 3% year-over-year adjusted EPS growth.
  • Full year 2026: total revenueTotal Company reported revenue for full-year 2026 is expected to be in the range of $6.479 billion to $6.497 billion.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted EPSThe Company is updating its full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to the range of $14.60 to $14.70, which represents 11% to 12% year-over-year adjusted EPS growth and is 13% to 14% on a constant currency basis.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
